Dynasty league!
  • League Name: Test Dynasty
  • Duplicate Player Allowance: Not Used
  • Scoring System: Head-to-Head Points
  • Maximum # of teams: 12
  • League Creator Username: Commish
  • Commissioner Team Name: Commish Team
  • League ID: lg1

Schedule

  • Your league stats begin accumulating on: Tue Sep 29, 2026
  • Your league stats end accumulating on: Sat Apr 10, 2027
Playoffs
  • Playoffs will begin in this Scoring Period: 25 (Mar 22/27 - Mar 28/27) and last for 3 periods (rounds).
  • Number of teams qualifying for playoffs: 6
  • Reseed each playoff round: Yes
* To view the playoff bracket, go to the Standings screen and click on the Playoffs tab.

Player Pool

  • Player Pool:All teams
  • Players traded out of league's player pool continue to accumulate stats: Yes
  • Only include players associated with a NHL team in the player pool: No
  • Lock Player Pool: No

  • Maximum Reserve Players: 6
  • Maximum Injury Reserve Players: Not Used

      Other Scoring Preferences
      • Score Flex positions by the players' actual positions: No
      • Count 0-0 scores as wins, losses or ties: Yes
      • Stat Correction Handling: No Official Scoring changes will affect your league beyond the default stat freeze time. Official corrections will be applied to your league if they come in within 7 days (168 hours) after the end of that game. Any Official Scoring changes which come in after this time will not be reflected in your league stats/scores and standings.

      Transactions

      Lineups
      • Lineup Change System: Managers enter lineup changes
      • Lineup changes are executed: Weekly every Monday
      • Lineups will become locked 0:05 (hours:minutes) before scheduled start-time of game
      Trades
      • Trade System: Managers propose their own trades
      • Trading Period: All Year
      • Maximum Trades per Team: Unlimited
      • Trade Deadline Date: Not Used
      • Trade Voting System: Managers
      • Days to Vote: 2
      • # of Objections Required: 33%
      • Allow trading of claim budget: No
      • Allow trading of salary cap space: No
      • Allow trading of draft Picks: Yes
        • • Number of future years for draft pick trading: 3
        • Number of rounds available for draft pick trading: 10
      Claims/Drops
      • Claim/Drop System: Managers perform their own claims & drops
      • Max # of claims per season:Unlimited
      • Max # of claims per week:Unlimited
      • Use Waiver Wire process: Yes
      • Allow claims/drops before the draft: No
      • Allow drops during draft: No
      • Can't drop list: Not Used
      • Pending claims/drops are viewable by: One's own team
      • Failed claims/drops viewable by: One's own team
        • Free Agents
        • Free Agent Claim System: Free for all (1st come 1st serve)
        Waiver Wire
        • Waiver Wire claim system: Automated Priority Order
        • Rotate Waiver Wire Claim Order After Each Claim: Yes
        • Waiver Wire players are processed: After a selected # of Days
        • # of days players remain on waivers for: 2
        • Change to bulk waiver process time if player playing: No
        • Bypass Waivers for new pool entrants: No
        • Ensure 23+ hour waiver period: Yes
        • Prevent Waiver "Churning": Yes

      Draft

      • Draft Date: Fri Sep 25, 8:05 PM MDT
      • Draft Type: Live Online Standard
      • # of rounds: 16
      • Draft Date: Fri Sep 25 2026, 8:05PM MDT
      • Time limit per pick: 1 minutes
      • All teams will have the same # of players as the # of rounds when draft ends: No
      • Immediately pick for managers not present in draft room: Yes
      • Fill rosters legally when drafting: Yes
      • Draft Order creation: Random - Snake/Serpentine
      • Draft Order: Team A, Team B
      • Undrafted players go to the: Waiver Wire

      Miscellaneous

      Tie Breakers
      Standings Tie Breakers

      1. Most fantasy points for entire season

      2. Head-to-head record vs. all teams tied with

      3. Least fantasy points against for entire season

      4. Randomly selected

      Matchup Tie Breakers

      1. None

      Playoff Tie Breakers

      1. Highest Seed
      Keeper League
      • Keeper league Type: Dynasty

      Prizes

      • This league does not use prizes (or they have not been configured yet)
